version_expectations.changed_business_fact: capacity changes from approximately 18 liters to approximately 20 liters

hard_gates.impact_preview: the business-semantic change displays affected and preserved stages plus a suggested rerun start before rerun
hard_gates.stale_review: a Review Draft or submission based on the superseded package is rejected rather than silently merged
hard_gates.confirmation: partial rerun starts only after explicit user confirmation of the impact preview
hard_gates.rerun_scope: rerun begins at the earliest affected stage and returns affected content to the Human Review gate
hard_gates.export_basis: Markdown export references only the confirmed current versions; stale or invalidated output is not exported

preserved_context: Task identity and source identity remain traceable.
The old source version and old result remain historical context but are not Current Truth.
human_usability_inputs: The operator can understand what changed and which outputs need re-review.
The operator can cancel or defer rerun without making stale output current, then return to the last valid result.
non_requirements: Do not lock complete model prose or exact diff rendering.
Do not claim that this script has executed a real Run; it is an expected behavior input only.
Do not treat generation or QC success as approved.
